_note: VFX's beam-clash look (docs/vfx/clash-look.md): the point where two beams meet, drawn as rippling, glowing air with distortion, colour and patterns erupting from it, instead of the old solid white flare. Read by render/vfx/clash_look.gd and clash_view.gd, never by the sim. Each side's look is COMPOSED from data: the fighter's lane colour (Art's, from his aura) and his beam flavour (energy.json: the second tint's hue shift, the beam's pattern), then this file's row for his roster id (lower case), then the row for the form he is in (`forms`, keyed by his form step), then every `situations` entry whose condition holds. A new fighter is a data row; a special case of his (a form, a stance, a state the sim can read off him) is a `situations` entry: {read: a path off the fighter (tier, form.step, form.branch, ...), is / min / max: the condition, set: any of the row's keys}. Nothing here is code. Present rows: protagonist, rival, reference (on main), and empress and cyborg (rows only: their kits are parked, docs/combat/energy-movesets.md, and nothing reads them until those fighters are on the roster). A fighter with no row gets `default`.

press._note: The press (docs/vfx/clash-look.md, Orb 2026-11-01): each clash beam's head flares and bells out into a flat sheet where it meets the other, and eddies shed off its rim and roll back along it, driven by that side's power, the struggle's knot and its surges. flare_k: the head's extra radius as a share; sheet_k: how flat and wide the front lies (0 to 1); eddy_k: the eddies' depth as a share of the radius; eddy_v: the speed they roll back at, units a second; eddy_wl: the distance between two, in units (a point sees one go by at eddy_v / eddy_wl Hz: 0.9 or slower); reach: how far back from the head it all reaches, units; hue: the share of the eddies that takes the second tint; surge_k: the extra depth a surge's swell adds at the head; calm_k: the share kept under Reduce flashing or reduced motion (half the depth at 0.6 of the speed).

protagonist._source: docs/combat/energy-movesets.md: Breakwater, broad and blunt, pushes as a wall; beam pattern boil (energy.json)

rival._source: docs/combat/energy-movesets.md: Lance Sheaf, thin straight lances that tighten and press; beam pattern facets (energy.json)

empress._source: docs/combat/energy-movesets.md (parked): Hem Sweep bows like an overdrawn wire. Her colours are Art's moss (Legal RL-221: no gold, white or red in an aura, ring or flash; the gold #c9a227 is her flight-line ribbon rim only, never here). A row only: she is not on the roster

cyborg._source: docs/combat/energy-movesets.md (parked): Furnace Vent sputters and surges; molten slag orange with scrap-metal grey. A row only: he is not on the roster

shockwave._note: The clash's shockwave at the meeting point (docs/vfx/clash-shockwave.md, Legal RL-246). VFX's PROPOSED numbers until Game Design rules them. Growth: a thin ground ring at most every ring_gap_s, radius grow_r0 to grow_r1 with the struggle's swell (knot_s); never per pulse. Release at the end: rings out to World's meeting crater (release_r by the pair's mean tier 1 to 4, times the root of f_end by the ending), over release_s, starting release_delay ticks after the cue; a local dust dome (dome_k of the radius, at most dome_max). Above height_reach the point is an air burst (air_k of the radius, no dome).
